passages.text: Tamberline Supply is Kestrova's authorized US distributor for the KS-200 and KS-400 product lines.
Authorized distributors receive 25% off the list price and must meet a minimum annual purchase of USD 120,000.
Distributors provide first-line technical support and must escalate unresolved issues within 48 hours to Kestrova Customer Support, led by Marcus Ellery.
